entities.summary: Francisco de Asís "Francis" Franco y Martínez-Bordiú, 11th Marquess of Villaverde, is a Spanish aristocrat and manager of several business associations. Besides his real estate businesses, he owns many parking spaces in Madrid. He is the grandson of Spanish dictator Francisco Franco.
